Introduction

HALF&HALF was a pre-debut six-member boy group under ICE Entertainment. They held their first showcase on April 6, 2024, and released their first pre-debut single “Together” on May 14, 2024.

On July 26, 2025, it was announced that the group’s official Instagram account would be terminated and the members would go their separate ways. The remaining members have transferred to Spheres Entertainment and will continue as part of JNXSK or BOY19ER (yet to be specified).
